title: 12 Best Toronto Night Markets
description: Discover the 12 best Toronto night markets for 2026! From global street food at Street Eats Market to cultural festivals like Taste of the Danforth, find insider tips, what to eat, and prices for your ultimate foodie adventure.

places.name: Street Eats Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Whatever looks new and exciting, but always seek out their creative bubble waffles or artisanal burgers.

places.name: Toronto Waterfront Night Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Stinky Tofu if you're brave, giant squid skewers, or a classic mango sticky rice. Don't forget a refreshing bubble tea.

places.name: Taste of the Danforth
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Authentic souvlaki straight from the grill, loukoumades (Greek donuts with honey), and a strong Greek coffee.

places.name: Smorgasburg Toronto
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for viral food trends like ramen burgers or unique ice cream concoctions, but don't miss any vendor specializing in artisanal sandwiches.

places.name: Union Summer Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A craft beer from the pop-up bar paired with gourmet tacos or a creative hot dog from a local vendor.

places.name: Kensington Market Pedestrian Sundays (Evening)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A delicious, cheap taco from one of the many taquerias, a freshly baked empanada, or explore the diverse vegan options available.

places.name: Taste of Little Italy
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A fresh panzerotti, arancini, or a generous scoop of artisanal gelato. Don't forget a cannoli for dessert.

places.name: TD Salsa on St. Clair
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Authentic tacos, arepas, empanadas, or a refreshing jug of horchata or mango smoothie.

places.name: Night Market 6ix
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for their colorful dessert creations like dragon's breath snacks, creatively topped fries, or innovative bao buns.

places.name: Canadian National Exhibition (CNE) Food Building & Midway
places.priceRange: $30-60 CAD / $22-44 USD per person (excluding entrance fee)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The latest viral CNE food invention (e.g., pickle pizza, ketchup ice cream), but always grab a classic Tiny Tom Donuts or a deep-fried Mars bar.

places.name: Markham Night Market (e.g., Lucky Lion Night Market)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grilled squid, takoyaki, various skewers (lamb, beef, chicken), and a refreshing fruit slush or specialty bubble tea.

places.name: Taste of India Food Festival
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Samosa chaat, various dosas, butter chicken poutine (a Toronto fusion twist), and refreshing mango lassi.
